text: Abeyance. A matter held, not dropped, until its owner decides.
At two fourteen, Ines's nightly Hermes job finished its tests, and reached the step that pushes a release. She was asleep.
Abeyance stops that one step before it runs, keeps the work already done, and sends one card to her phone. Written by code.
She replies resume. Abeyance checks the repo is the one she was shown. Hermes asks her to confirm the exact command. One tap, and the job finishes. A real push. A real release.
If the repo moved, nothing runs, no model is called, and she is told exactly what changed.
Strangers, replays, disguised commands and subagents are held too. Twenty eight of twenty eight break cases blocked. Two of a hundred and fifty everyday commands held by mistake, and published.
Five hooks, durable state, and Hermes's own approval gate as the authority. More than a prompt or a skill could do.
Abeyance. Night runs without blind trust.
